buildCommand: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build

rewrites.comment: REPLACE <space-url> with your Hugging Face Space URL, e.g. https://cmrpi-emc-helpline.hf.space — proxying keeps the API same-origin, so no CORS setup is needed and the CSP below stays strict.
SPA fallback: every other route serves the app shell.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self'
